title: Commands and the command bar
steps: Press ⌘P (Ctrl+P off a Mac) and type a few letters of a note's name, such as `rl` for Reading list. Enter opens it.
In the same box, type a name that doesn't exist, such as `Meeting notes`. The last item creates it.
Press ⌘⇧P (Ctrl+Shift+P) for every command, with its shortcut. Or type `>` in the ⌘P box.
Move through the list with the arrow keys, Ctrl-N and Ctrl-P, or Ctrl-J and Ctrl-K. Esc closes it and puts you back in the editor.
⌘S saves, like `:w`. Try Go back from the command bar after opening a few notes.
